label: Work
intent: Office work, communication and browsing. WSL and Docker stopped to free their VM memory.

apps.note: Only apps the user listed here are closed or launched. Protected apps are never uninstalled or blocked.

suggestedToClose.why: Not running at inspection (2026-10-01), so RAM not measured; ramImpact estimated as low (unknown). Steam typically uses several hundred MB with webhelpers. Mode-driven: launch in Game mode only.

Hosts Windows AI workloads (Copilot, Recall, Click to Do, AI search in Settings). A Microsoft Q&A moderator suggests Manual as a workaround when those features are not used; other users report about 5 GB RAM in idle WorkloadsSessionHost.exe on 25H2 (not measured here; the service process itself measured about 1.9 MB). Stopping it disables those AI features only; Office, apps and Windows Update are unaffected per the same thread.
